full_prompt_en: A square hard-edged anime close-up shows a battle-worn dark-haired man glaring against a vivid red field. The background is a rough crimson plane with black scuffs and faint horizontal cracks, visible mostly at the left and lower edge. The man's head fills nearly the whole image, his thick black hair cropped by the top border and falling in jagged strands across his brow. He turns slightly toward the left but looks outward with narrow, intense eyes beneath heavy angled eyebrows. Warm tan skin is broken by many short black scratches and reddish abrasions along the cheek, jaw, and forehead. A broad black shadow covers much of the left side of the face and reaches under the eyes; the right cheek and nose catch stronger orange light. His mouth is closed and tense, and the jawline is sharply drawn. A dark red collar or scarf wraps the neck and shoulders at the lower right, merging with the shadowed clothing below. The composition is so close that there is no independent setting, only the rough red plane and the face pressing against the frame. Fine hatching varies in density around the eyes and cheek, while flat ink masses give the hair and deep shadows decisive weight. Tiny stippled marks roughen the warm skin and red ground, making the printed surface feel worn. Light enters from the upper right and front, carving hard bright planes into the face while the opposite side remains nearly black. The overall composition is confrontational and tense, using compressed cropping, red-black contrast, and abrasive line texture to hold the viewer on the fixed gaze.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、边缘硬朗的动漫特写呈现一名饱经战斗的深发男子，在鲜红底色前怒视。背景是一片粗糙绯红平面，带黑色擦痕和淡薄横向裂纹，主要露在左侧和下缘。男子头部几乎填满整幅，浓黑头发被上缘裁掉，锯齿般发束落过眉毛。他略向左转，却用狭窄而强烈的眼睛从厚重斜眉下望向画外。暖土黄色皮肤被许多短黑刮痕和脸颊、下颌、额头上的红色擦伤打断。宽阔黑影覆盖半边脸并伸到眼下；另一侧脸颊和鼻子承接更强的橙色光。他闭着嘴，神情紧绷，下颌线刻画得锋利。深红衣领或围巾在右下环住脖颈与肩部，融入下方暗色衣服。构图近到没有独立场所，只剩粗糙红面与挤压画框的面孔。细排线在眼与颊周围疏密变化，平坦墨块赋予头发和深影决定性的重量。细点纹粗化暖色皮肤与红底，让印刷表面显得磨旧。光从右上前方进入，在面部刻出坚硬明亮平面，使反侧仍近乎全黑。整体构图直面观者而紧张，以压缩裁切、红黑对比和磨擦般的线条肌理将视线固定在怒视上。
style_prompt_en: The gritty anime rendering sets warm tan and scarlet against heavy near-black ink, with a close crop that removes nearly all spatial context. Broad shadow shapes create the main value structure, while short slashing hatches, stipple, and scraped marks supply tactile abrasion. Edges are angular and decisive near the focal region, becoming rougher where dark masses merge with the surrounding red. Highlights are concentrated in hard warm planes, and the opposite side falls quickly into black, producing strong directional drama. A nearly flat saturated ground gives the textured form graphic force rather than depth through perspective. Fine line density tightens around the point of greatest contrast and loosens toward the margins. The overall effect is severe, urgent, and printlike, using economical color and aggressive mark making to carry emotional pressure.
style_prompt_zh: 这种粗粝动漫渲染让暖土黄与猩红对照厚重近黑墨色，贴近裁切几乎移除所有空间语境。宽阔阴影块建立主要明度结构，短促劈斩排线、点纹与刮擦笔迹提供可触的磨损感。焦点附近边缘棱角鲜明且果断，深色体块融入周围红色之处则更粗糙。高光集中为坚硬暖色平面，反侧迅速落入黑暗，形成强烈定向戏剧性。近乎平坦的饱和背景给带肌理的形体图形力量，而非依靠透视纵深。细线密度在最强对比处收紧，向边缘逐渐松开。整体效果严厉、紧迫且带印刷感，以节制颜色和猛烈落笔承载情绪压力。
